title: i fear heated rivalry club night changed my brain chemistry 🫠🏒 would ...
transcript: I'm coming to the cottage. We are going to Heated Rivalry club night. I've been seeing these videos literally everywhere. The second that they announced they were doing one in New York I grabbed tickets immediately. Club is not really my thing, but dancing to Heated Rivalry fan edits all night very much is. To me it's dance or sit on my couch and watch them so the line to get in was literally all the way down the street but people were so excited to be there. The vibes were immaculate. It's 10:22. It took us almost an hour to get in and to get a coat checked it say doors 9:30 show 9:30 but show is actually 10:30. They did have themed cocktails. I had to get the Hollander cause I really wanted a ginger ale based something. And then we made our way to the floor and it was packed. But honestly, we had no problem finding a spot in the back near the bar. It was ideal. We did a countdown and then it was showtime. And I gotta say, this is the only kind of clubbing I think I ever wanna do. Like, maybe I would go clubbing more if I can watch my favorite TV Shows while doing it. They played Rihanna and Britney and Harry Styles and Sabrina all while playing clips from the show and really fun fan edits. i’m obsessed Don't worry Skip and François were not left out, and neither were our favorite girlies Now it was very crowded. Sometimes too crowded. There were definitely people that were too intoxicated, but in general I thought the crowd was pretty respectful and older than I was expecting. It's a 19+ venue but there were plenty of people who are in their late 20s, 30s and beyond. They also had a good mix of clubby music and also songs from the show. They even brought up the girl that did the “I'm coming to the cottage” beat as part of the fan edits they'd also play clips from all of Hudson and Connor's press and viral social media moments which is so funny cause I kept thinking about how three months ago no one knew who these two were and now we're at a club dancing to videos of Hudson Williams stretching with Jimmy Fallon on Late Night. My favorite moment of the whole night was I'll believe in anything. A. because I couldn't believe we were singing Wolf Parade at a club. B, because watching the audience react to Skip’s kiss was so magical. I don't think that moment will ever not move me. Around 1 ish we decided we were old and ready to leave. And we were sad because we missed ‘all the things she said’. Literally we grabbed our coats, we were on our way out and we heard it start and ran back to the floor I can’t breathe and they went right into the Harrison remix. Which was the perfect way to end the night. I just loved dancing the night away celebrating queer joy & heated rivalry ALL THE THINGS SHE SAID my goodness! We picked the perfect time to leave we’re old and we went to a rave. Just got home. That's so good. It’s 2am in the morning. That was so much fun. I had the best time ever. I would definitely go again.
